note: Human-reviewed EXTERNAL identities for thesis mentions that will never get a person_slug. Of the 45 unattributed authors/supervisors researched for the name sweep, these are the ones where CISUC's directory is RIGHT to be silent: an ISEP professor who co-supervised one thesis, a CERN project leader, a UFPB academic, a Critical Software founder, graduates who left. Nothing can match them and nothing should. What was wrong was only the DISPLAY — the app printed a bare "(unattributed)" beside a name whose person, affiliation and source are known. This file supplies that, and only that. It is display metadata for ONE SPECIFIC THESIS MENTION; it is NOT an identity table and it is NEVER matcher input. analysis/name_match.py must never import it, no entry carries or can carry a person_slug, and the key is a MENTION — (handle, name_raw, role) — not a name, so a future thesis repeating the same string inherits nothing: same-name-different-person is this corpus's core trap ("Martins, Pedro" is two different people two years apart). That is what separates it from option C, the thesis-name -> person lookup the Product Owner rejected, which forced the matcher's output and applied to every thesis forever. analysis/external_people.py refuses an entry whose thesis_people row is anything other than match_status='unmatched', so this file structurally cannot shadow a matched row, and a future matcher improvement breaks the build until the obsolete entry is removed rather than quietly contradicting it. identity_coverage does not move: an external person is correctly unresolved, not newly resolved. source_url and evidence are mandatory and are not decoration. See docs/thesis-attribution.md.
